n12999103.definition: One of a set of three paired appendages on the thorax of a decapod crustacean, located just posterior to the maxillae and used in feeding.
examples: An appendage which is modified to assist in feeding is known as a maxilliped or gnathopod.

n12999544.definition: A thin lamina of elastic cartilage forming the central portion of the epiglottis.

n12999811.definition: a bet on a weaker competitor that is given a head start by a bookmaker.
examples: You can place a 0-2 handicap bet on Brazil vs. Cyprus.

n12999999.definition: An epistatic gene is a gene that determines whether or not a given trait will be expressed.
examples: The gene responsible for albinism is an epistatic gene.
